content:
harpreet: anyone else seeing a spike of OOMs on the Sparkline-13B canary after flipping batch_packing on? :thinking_face:

toni: yep, started ~14:02 UTC. OOMs only when we set max_new_tokens=64 and batch_packing=true on the int4 canary. GPU memory climbs steadily then boom.

lucy: can you paste a brief pod log snippet?

toni: from the pod that died:```
[2026-03-20T14:02:11Z] ERROR runtime: CUDA OOM when allocating 2.1GiB for attention_kv_cache
[2026-03-20T14:02:11Z] WARN runtime: observed kv_slots_in_use=0.92, kv_fragmentation=0.28, slot_reserve=0.1
[2026-03-20T14:02:11Z] ERROR inference: OOM at token 34 of response
```

eval-bot: perf-eval: quant=int4+pack -> latency p95 +12ms, token-cost -18%, quality delta (eval-suite-2026) BLEU-like -2.3%.

harpreet: quick hypothesis: batch_packing + aggressive int4 reduces steady memory but increases KV-slot churn for mixed-length traffic; fragmentation + low slot_reserve -> transient allocation peaks -> OOM.

noah: repro steps locally:```
redwood deploy --model sparkline-13b --quant-profile int4 --batch-packing true --max_new_tokens 64 --microbatch 4
abtest run --rps 30 --seq_len 256 --duration 10m
```
reproduces OOMs in a few minutes at ~0.8 concurrency.

toni: lowering microbatch to 2 cuts OOM frequency but p95 latency increases. tradeoffs everywhere.

lucy: mitigation options: 1) rollback to int8 for canary, 2) keep int4 but increase slot_reserve and enable kv_trim/soft_evict to smooth fragmentation spikes, 3) change pack heuristic to avoid packing short requests with long ones. also consider bumping default max_new_tokens for sparkline to avoid pathological short-gen mixes.

harpreet: immediate: rollback canary to int8 to stop customer-facing OOMs. medium: mem-frag benchmarking + tune pack heuristics.

toni: I'll rollback canary and set Sparkline default max_new_tokens=256 for now.

deploy-bot: Canary rollback initiated by toni -> sparkline-13b v1.1 (target cluster: gpu-pool-3).

lucy: config snippet to test in isolated canary:```json
{
  "quant_profile": "int4",
  "batch_packing": true,
  "microbatch": 2,
  "kv_trim_threshold": 0.8,
  "soft_evict": true,
  "slot_reserve": 0.15
}
```

noah: bench script to reproduce mem-frag:```
./bench_mem_frag.sh --model sparkline-13b --rps 40 --mix "{short:60,long:40}" --duration 15m
```

harpreet: created ticket INF-4891 with plan + artifacts: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4891 :thumbsup:

toni: attaching canary logs and failing traces to INF-4891. will also run the int8 vs int4 eval-suite.

lucy: follow-up TODOs recorded in INF-4891: run mem-frag bench across slot_reserve {0.10,0.15,0.20}; run int8 vs int4 quality/eval-suite; test packing heuristic variants (no-pack-for-short, pack-only-same-len-bucket).

harpreet: assign to toni/lucy. once kv_trim+soft_evict shows stability without perf regression, we can slowly re-enable int4 canary and consider reducing max_new_tokens default if eval quality holds. :thumbsup:
